{{Quote|If it's fashionable, I've got it.|Nelva Stato|<ref name="TOR" />}}
'''Nelva Stato''' was a [[Gender/Legends|female]] [[Human/Legends|Human]] who lived during the [[Galactic War]] between the [[Sith Empire (Post–Great Hyperspace War)|Sith Empire]] and the [[Galactic Republic/Legends|Galactic Republic]]. A merchant like her relatives [[Meridat Stato|Meridat]], [[Felusia Stato|Felusia]], and [[Clem Stato|Clem]], Nelva Stato sold furniture and decorations on the [[Space station/Legends|space station]] [[Carrick Station]] with Nelva.<ref name="TOR" />

==Behind the scenes==
A Decorations vendor who appears on the Republic Fleet, Nelva Stato was added to the [[Star Wars video games|video game]] ''[[Star Wars: The Old Republic]]'' in the [[2014]] Digital Expansion [[Star Wars: The Old Republic: Galactic Strongholds|''Galactic Strongholds'']]. While her fellow merchants Clem Stato and [[Estah Kloy]] appear on both the Imperial and Republic Fleets, Nelva Stato is replaced by Meridat Stato on the Imperial Fleet.<ref name="TOR" />
